screens.question: How do I install them?
screens.answer: Download the zip on your phone, open Files, then set from the photo library. The readme covers iOS and Android.

screens.question: Is desktop included?
screens.answer: This is the mobile cut. The desktop composition, when available, is sold separately.

screens.question: Licence
screens.answer: Personal use on your own devices. No resale, no print runs, no NFT minting.

sound.question: Spotify and Apple Music ready?
sound.answer: Yes. Every cover ships at the exact spec distributors ask for.

sound.question: Does the licence cover the release?
sound.answer: Yes, a release licence for one project is included with the purchase.

sound.question: Can I resell it?
sound.answer: No — each cover is sold once and retired from the archive right after.

items.question: What do I get after buying?
items.answer: A download link with the full-resolution files and a short readme covering sizes and licence.

items.question: Mobile and desktop?
items.answer: Both, sold as separate collections — each composed for that screen, never cropped from the other.

items.question: What resolution?
items.answer: Wallpapers at 7680 × 4320 and 1440 × 3120. Covers at 3000 × 3000 RGB.

items.question: Can I use it commercially?
items.answer: Cover artwork includes a release licence for one project. Wallpapers are personal use only.

items.question: How fast is delivery?
items.answer: Instant — the link is on the confirmation screen and in your account.
